Unchanged lines around the diff were read from the fetched objects (`git show` on a pinned ref); nothing was checked out, built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

Public surface of `@object-ui/app-shell` is `exports["."]` → `dist/index.d.ts` ← `src/index.ts`; the recent-items names reach it through `hooks/useRecentItems.ts`.

1. **`RecentItem` becomes `RecentNamedItem | RecentTextItem`** — right, and a narrowing. The four named kinds (`object`, `dashboard`, `page`, `report`) carry `name` and no `label`; `record` and `metadata` keep `label`. A consumer reading `item.label` off an unnarrowed entry no longer compiles (TS2339, the dev's reverse check against the built declarations). The changeset's Breaking paragraph says so.
2. **`addRecentItem` takes `RecentItemInput`** — right, a narrowing of the accept set: a label-carrying input for a named kind, and a named input without `name`, are refused at compile time (TS2353). The two in-repo callers compile: the tracker (identity shape) and `views/RecordDetailView.tsx` :667 (`type: 'record'` with `label: recordTitle`, a text kind).
3. **Six new entry exports** — right, a widening: `useRecentItemLabel` (value) and the types `RecentItemLabelResolver`, `RecentItemInput`, `RecentItemType`, `RecentNamedItem`, `RecentTextItem`, all re-exported through `hooks/useRecentItems.ts` into `src/index.ts` :48 and :66–:71. The changeset lists all six.
4. **`metadataText`, `findByName`, `LabelledRecord` exported from `hooks/useNavTargetLabel.ts`** — right that this is NOT a public-surface change: `src/index.ts` does not reach `useNavTargetLabel.ts`, so the three exports are module-internal; the two function bodies are unchanged.
5. **`UseTrackRouteAsRecentOptions` unchanged** — right: `label` stays on the `ObjectLike` pick so the options type does not move; `useTrackRouteAsRecent` is not reached from the entry in any case. Its behaviour moves: `titleize` deleted, dashboard/page/report recorded as `{ id: 'kind:name', type, name, href }` with `name` decoded by `safeDecode` and `href` built from the raw segment, so a revisit of the same route yields equal content.
6. **Persisted shape (`ui.recent` and localStorage `objectui-recent-items:u:ID`)** — right, and both arms are present. Written shape for named kinds moves from `{ id, label, href, type, visitedAt }` to `{ id, type, name, href, visitedAt }`. Read-back is one reader, `readEntry`/`readList`, applied to localStorage, `adapter.load()`, cross-tab sync and `addRecentItem`'s argument; a legacy named entry takes its `name` from the `type:` prefix of `id` and its minted label is dropped (changeset paragraph 2; pinned from localStorage and from the adapter, and the adapter read writes nothing back). The read accept set NARROWS against the base reader, which kept any entry with a string `id`: an entry with an unknown `type`, a missing `href`, a record/metadata entry without a string `label`, and a named-kind entry whose `id` has no `type:` prefix and no `name` are now dropped. The only writer of the last case is a host calling `addRecentItem` with a hand-made id, a call the Breaking paragraph already refuses at compile time; the drop is stated in the PR body and pinned (`{ id: 'my-page', type: 'page' }` in `RecentItemsProvider.test.tsx`), and the changeset covers it only implicitly ("read by identity, which was always in the entry's `id`" — true of the tracker's writes). Named as the one under-spelled corner; not a failing gap.
7. **Published components whose rendered behaviour moves** — right: `UnifiedSidebar` (`index.ts` :144) and `CommandPalette` (:157) directly; Home (`RecentApps`, `HomeContinue`), Studio home and the console shell through internal modules. Every surface that rendered the stored label now calls `useRecentItemLabel()`; `git grep` at the head finds no remaining `item.label` read on a recent entry in non-test source. The changeset names the five surfaces. `useMetadata()` returns a frozen no-op outside its provider (`packages/react/src/context/AppShellContext.tsx` :107–:113), so a host mounting `CommandPalette` outside `MetadataProvider` does not crash — and its recent group lists `record` entries only, which carry their own text. No new provider requirement is added.
8. **`useRecentItemLabel` holds no rule of its own** — right: object/dashboard go through `useNavTargetLabel` (the sidebar's resolver, objectui#9868); page/report compose the same `metadataText` + `findByName` pair over `useObjectLabel().pageLabel` / `reportLabel` (`packages/i18n/src/useObjectLabel.ts` :466, :473); machine name is the backstop; text kinds return their stored label. The `useMetadata()` getters for `dashboards`, `reports`, `pages` call `ensureType` when idle (`MetadataProvider.tsx` :1078–:1086), which is the lazy per-type list read the PR body's "Behaviour to know" describes — right.
9. **"No change, no write"** — right at both levels. `commit` refuses a list equal to `itemsRef.current` (no state, no localStorage, no `adapter.save()`); `addRecentItem` is a no-op when the head's `contentOf` (id, type, href, name-or-label) is unchanged, so no fresher `visitedAt` is written; decisions are taken outside state updaters. The list→view route pair for an object produces one entry with one `href`, so it is one visit (pinned). A record revisit: `recordTitle` starts `undefined` (`RecordDetailView.tsx` :428) and the add fires only once it resolves, so a revisit with the same title is a head no-op; a title that resolves differently is a changed head and is written, as the changeset says. Adapter hydration still writes localStorage (`saveRecent(sane)`) on every load — pre-existing, localStorage only, no PATCH.
10. **Done-when against the diff** — identity stored, label at render in the current locale: yes (`RecentApps.labelAtRender-11678` pins the three measured items in en and zh-CN over one stored list, with no minted string). A visit that does not change the list writes nothing: yes (store guard and head no-op, each ablated red by the dev). Audit question untouched: yes. The named pin "revisiting the most recent item makes no write" is held in jsdom by the tracker suite; the live console reading remains unmeasured (③ item 4).
11. **Gate script** — right: `scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` :1090 repoints the `home.recentApps.itemType.` family at the `RecentItemType` union; the script's reader supports `kind: 'union'` (:1177), and the family stays six members. `ci.yml` :517 runs `pnpm check:i18n-keys` in the Lint job, which concluded success on this head.
